translations.text: The book of the vision of Nahum, son of Elkosh.
The Lord is a jealous God, taking vengeance in anger on those who oppose him and destroying his enemies.
The Lord is patient, and his power is great, but he will by no means acquit. The Lord’s path is through destruction and earthquake, and the clouds are the dust beneath his feet.
He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and he makes all the rivers dry up. Bashan has withered, along with Carmel, and the crops of Lebanon have been shaken.
The mountains trembled before him, and the hills shook. The whole earth hid itself before him, along with everyone who lives in it.
Who can stand before his wrath, and who can resist his furious anger? His anger dissolves rulers, and the rocks shattered before him.
The Lord is good to those who wait patiently for him on the day of their affliction. He knows those who fear him.
And with his devastating advance he will come upon everyone who rises up against him, and darkness will pursue his enemies.
You are plotting against the Lord. He will bring about destruction; he will not take vengeance twice at once through affliction.
For they will be cut down to their roots like a patch of thorns, and they will be devoured like tangled bindweed, and you will become like a patch of very dry straw.
A plot comes from you against the Lord, as you plan evil while they oppose you.
These are the things the Lord says as he rules over many waters…
